How do I cancel automatic renewal subscription for Cleaner One Pro?

No Comments

Before You Start
First, identify where you purchased your subscription:
Apple App Store (macOS)
In-app purchase (Windows)
Online (Trend Micro Website)
Cancel via Apple App Store (macOS)
Open the
App Store
on your Mac.
Click your name in the bottom-left corner (sign in if needed).
Select
Account Settings
(or
View Information
on some versions).
Under
Manage → Subscriptions
, click
Manage
.
Find your
One Series
subscription, then click
Edit → Cancel Subscription
and confirm.
Tip:
You can also go to your profile →
Subscriptions
to access this page.
Cancel an Online Purchase or In-app Purchase (Windows)
Sign in
to your Trend Micro account
Go to
My Trend Micro Account
and log in with your email and password.
Manage your subscription
Under the
Licenses
tab, find your active plan and click
Manage Subscription
.
Start cancellation
Locate
Cleaner One Pro Subscription
and click
Cancel Subscription
.
A pop-up will explain what happens when auto-renew is turned off.
Continue
Review the message and click
Continue
.
Provide feedback
Complete the short form and click
Submit
.
Confirm your choice
Select
Stop Auto Renew
to proceed, or
Stay Subscribed
to keep your plan active.
What Happens After You Cancel?
Your subscription will remain active until the end of your current billing period. After that, it will not renew, and access to features and protection will end.
